Welcome to the NVIDIA Developer Program

As a member, you can now access tools and training to help you
succeed with NVIDIA technologies. Get started:

💻 Developer Tools

* Get free access to NVIDIA NIM™ 
( https://developer.nvidia.com/nim/?ncid=em-nurt-723851 ) API
endpoints and downloadable containers for research, development
and testing with optimized AI models.
* Find SDKs, libraries, and performance analysis tools in our
Developer Tools Catalog 
( https://developer.nvidia.com/developer-tools-catalog?ncid=em-nurt-276229 )
.
* Report bugs 
( https://developer.nvidia.com/nvidia_bug/add?ncid=em-nurt-525179 )
directly to NVIDIA.

📚 Learning and Community

* Keep up to date on the latest technical breakthroughs through
our technical blog 
( https://developer.nvidia.com/blog/?ncid=em-nurt-520369 ), video
library 
( https://www.nvidia.com/en-us/on-demand/?ncid=em-nurt-881985 ),
and research hub 
( https://research.nvidia.com/publications?ncid=em-nurt-169554 ).
* Talk to other developers and find solutions on our Discord 
( https://discord.com/invite/nvidiadeveloper?ncid=em-nurt-793667 )
and Forums 
( https://forums.developer.nvidia.com/?ncid=em-nurt-235493 ).

👥 Programs that Support Growth

* NVIDIA Inception 
( https://www.nvidia.com/en-us/startups/?ncid=em-nurt-636555 ) for
startups: free developer courses and tools, customizable
marketing materials, and NVIDIA's global VC network​.
* NVIDIA Connect 
( https://www.nvidia.com/en-us/programs/isv/?ncid=em-nurt-278407 )
for ISVs: technical training, expert guidance, and preferred
pricing on NVIDIA technologies.
* Higher Education 
( https://developer.nvidia.com/higher-education-and-research?ncid=em-nurt-480392 )
: tailored resources for students, educators, and researchers.

Member Portal 
( https://developer.nvidia.com/nvidia-developer-program?ncid=em-nurt-724265 )


Thank you,
The NVIDIA Developer Team

This communication was originally sent to {email}. You’re
receiving this email communication because you are a member of
the NVIDIA Developer Program 
( https://developer.nvidia.com/developer-program ) and there has
been a change in your membership. If you have questions or would
like to leave the program, please contact us here 
( https://developer.nvidia.com/contact ).
